stories.title: Rename app Vyaapar -> MSW Global
stories.accept: Brand reads 'MSW Global' everywhere user-facing.

stories.title: Auto-refresh data lists (no manual reload)
stories.accept: Adding a product shows in POS without hard reload.

stories.title: Party supplier saved as customer
stories.accept: Creating a party as Supplier persists partyType=SUPPLIER.

stories.title: Password strength on staff-create + eye everywhere
stories.accept: Weak staff passwords rejected client-side.

stories.title: Add-category UI for items + expenses
stories.accept: User can create a category from the form.

stories.title: Credit settle: collect payment (unpaid -> paid)
stories.accept: One action records payment and flips toward PAID.

stories.title: Product return button in UI
stories.accept: Authorized user can issue a return; invoice REFUNDED.

stories.title: Payroll all staff/branches + advance/custom salary
stories.accept: One Generate covers every active staff; advance/custom amount.

stories.title: RBAC Super Admin / Manager / Biller scoping + route guards
stories.accept: Biller reaches only POS + today's sales; Manager scoped; Super Admin all.

stories.title: Barcode 2-up print + thermal bill customization
stories.accept: Print 2 barcode slips; thermal header/footer customizable.

stories.title: Signup page: rename CTA to 'Sign Up', visible password rules, no email verification
stories.accept: Primary button reads 'Sign Up' (not 'Start Free Trial'). A visible password-requirements hint is shown and weak passwords are rejected before submit (already enforced by zod + backend @IsStrongPassword). Signup logs the user in immediately with no email-verification step (confirm none exists).

stories.title: Friendly duplicate-SKU / unique-constraint errors (no 500)
stories.accept: Creating an item with an existing Item Code/SKU (unique [businessId,branchId,sku]) returns a clear 409 message like 'An item with this Item Code already exists' instead of HTTP 500 'Internal server error'. Implemented via a global Prisma exception filter that maps P2002/P2025 to friendly 4xx and names the field where possible.

stories.title: Housekeeping & Services keep the Hotel PMS header/tab bar
stories.accept: Clicking Housekeeping (and Services) from the Hotel PMS tab bar keeps the Hotel PMS header + tabs visible (route lives under /hotel/* or shares HotelLayout). Page styling is consistent with the rest of the hotel chrome. The 2 react/no-unescaped-entities lint errors on the housekeeping page are fixed.

stories.title: Replace window.prompt add-category with proper in-app UI
stories.accept: Adding an item category and an expense category uses an in-app input (inline field or dialog), NOT window.prompt/alert. New category is created via POST /categories and auto-selected immediately.

stories.title: Add-item required fields + backend validation
stories.accept: Creating an item requires (client + backend): Name, Category, Sale Price, Cost/Purchase Price, Unit, Opening Stock quantity ('no. of products'), and Barcode. Each missing field shows a clear message; the backend rejects incomplete payloads with a specific message. SKU/Item Code stays optional (auto-generated).

stories.title: Add-party required fields (Name + Phone + Type)
stories.accept: Creating a party requires (client + backend): Name, Phone, and an explicit Party Type (Customer/Supplier/Both, no silent default). Missing fields show a clear message; backend rejects incomplete payloads.

stories.title: Import: CSV support, real result feedback, downloadable template
stories.accept: The Utilities import accepts CSV (and still JSON) for items and parties, shows the backend result (created / skipped / per-row errors) instead of an always-success toast, and offers a 'Download template' with the expected columns. A duplicate SKU during import is reported as a row error, not a silent skip/500.

stories.title: Mobile shop/hotel switcher + mobile menu
stories.accept: On a narrow (mobile) screen a user can switch between shops and reach the Hotel PMS. The shop/entity switcher (currently only in the hidden-lg sidebar) is surfaced on mobile via the top bar or a menu/sheet, along with access to the 'More' nav (Hotel, Payroll, Staff, Settings).

stories.title: Low-stock notifications (make the bell functional)
stories.accept: When a stock-affecting transaction drops an item to at/below its minStock (or to 0), a Notification row is created (and emitted via events.gateway emitNotification) so the top-bar bell shows a low-stock alert. No other notification types needed.

stories.title: Hotel module: item category management (Food/Beverages/etc.)
stories.accept: A hotel user has a place to create and manage item categories for hotel items (Food, Beverages, Snacks, Desserts, Room Service) and can filter items/services by category. Reuses the retail Category backend (branch-scoped) or a hotel-scoped equivalent.

stories.title: RBAC: 3-tier labels in staff UI + multi-shop Manager assignment
stories.accept: Staff-create UI presents the three tiers (Super Admin / Manager / Biller) clearly, and a Manager (ADMIN/BRANCH_MANAGER) can be assigned to one OR MANY shops; that manager is scoped to exactly those shops. Follow-up to R8.

stories.title: Credit payment proper form (mode, amount, allocation)
stories.accept: The Collect Payment action uses an in-app form (not window.prompt): amount (defaults to full balance, partial allowed), payment mode (Cash/Bank), optional note, and optional per-invoice allocation. Ledger/invoice status updates as before.

stories.title: Return / Refund / Exchange: per-item + history
stories.accept: From a completed sale, an authorized user can return SPECIFIC items/quantities (not just the whole invoice), choose Refund (money back) or Exchange (return + new items), inventory auto-updates, and there is a Returns history view listing credit notes/returns.

stories.title: Customizable label/barcode designer
stories.accept: A label designer lets the user choose which fields print (Item Name, Category, Size, Colour, MRP, Barcode, SKU/Item Code, Batch), and set label width/height, margins, font size, alignment and barcode size, with thermal paper presets. Settings persist and the printed tag reflects them.

stories.title: Payroll: advance ledger auto-deduction + payslip + per-employee history
stories.accept: A salary advance can be recorded against an employee as a tracked balance that AUTO-deducts from future payroll runs until cleared; each payroll line can generate/print a payslip; and a per-employee salary history is viewable.
